title: The Story of the Atlantic Telegraph
lineage: 1898 edition, copyright 1892; retrospective by the promoter’s brother, including quoted engineers’ report. It describes an evolving programme, not proof that the old and new cables were the same artifact.

passages.note: Printed pp. 229–234: 1858 failure, Board of Trade investigation and lessons; pp. 294–295: Canning and colleagues compare the 1865 and 1858 cables; pp. 299–303: 1866 company and construction.
